reviews.review_description:
I really enjoy this game and find it both entertaining and engaging! However, I have encountered a few bugs that I hope the development team will consider addressing. For example, I've experienced instances where I successfully strike down a missile with my hand, yet it still manages to destroy my turret.

I also think the hand gun should either have unlimited use or offer players the opportunity to earn a permanent upgrade through gameplay. Power-ups and upgrades are an important part of gaming because they give players a sense of progression, accomplishment, and reward for their efforts.

Overall, I'm enjoying the game, and I think these improvements would make the experience even better.

developer_response.body:
Thanks for the detailed feedback and for your kind words, Cocopuff75!

Just to clarify one gameplay mechanic: by design, if you redirect a missile toward one of your own turrets, that turret can be destroyed by the impact. On the other hand, if you successfully redirect the missile toward enemy units, those enemies will be destroyed instead.

We also appreciate your suggestion regarding permanent power-ups. We've passed that feedback along to the developers for consideration.

We appreciate you taking the time to share your observations, and we'll keep investigating to make sure everything is working as intended. Thanks for playing! 🚀

Best regards,
The Xploit Tower Defense Team

reviews.review_title: A lot of fun and a good workout 💪 👾
reviews.review_description: Really fun game! Love how the mixed reality brings everything into your own space. Easy to pick up and it gets pretty intense as you progress especially with the music 😂 It’s also a really good workout with all the moving around! Nice ranking system too! 🖐️ 👾

developer_response.body:
Thanks for the great review, MrD4nny! 😊 

We're really happy to hear that you're enjoying Xploit Tower Defense. 

And yes, all that moving around is part of both the fun and the workout! 💪 We truly appreciate your support and hope you keep climbing the leaderboards. 

Best regards, 
The Xploit Tower Defense Team
